scope: Modern MS-FSA destination-directory sharing and failed-reauthentication notification cleanup; full SMB/NFS gates remain open.

checks: 32 file/directory and full/metadata-only parent combinations enforce destination WRITE sharing; parent DELETE rights and child share mode do not add obsolete restrictions
moving files/directories out of an exclusively opened source directory checks the destination rather than rejecting the source parent
SMB2.1/3.0/3.0.2/3.1.1 repeated signed/encrypted NTLM renewal preserves session ID, keys, opens and byte-range locks
expired authority reports NETWORK_SESSION_EXPIRED and renews the same open after an intervening management login
wrong proof and different-user renewal fail, release exclusive handles and complete signed/encrypted watches with NOTIFY_CLEANUP
fresh valid credentials cannot renew a revoked token or resurrect its exclusive open
LOGOFF during an incomplete renewal resets authentication state and permits a fresh encrypted session on the same transport
SESSION_SETUP for an unknown session does not abort another session's in-progress renewal or borrow its signing key

Current MS-FSA 2.1.5.15.12 uses READ|WRITE|DELETE, so this fixture succeeds rather than returning SHARING_VIOLATION. The full unmodified diagnostic remains recorded as failed, not passed.
